name: Entitree
description: Provides a hierarchical (tree) structure for content entities, with automatic path/alias management.
project_description: Entitree provides a tree (hierarchy) structure for content entities in a Drupal site. It stores the hierarchy as a nested set (via the allegiance-group/nested-set library) in per-language entitree_structure_{langcode} tables and models each node of the tree as an entitree_location content entity that references a real entity (or an empty placeholder location). Adding an entity to a position in the tree generates and maintains a path_alias for that entity based on the tree path, so Entitree effectively owns URL aliases for managed entities. Support for individual entity types is added through EntitreeEntityType plugins shipped in submodules (Entitree Node, Entitree Taxonomy Term). Entitree Location Rules automatically creates locations for entities matching configured rulesets (a Pathauto-style replacement within Entitree). Entitree Permissions layers tree-position-based, cascading allow/deny access rules (by role or user, with priority ordering) on top of Drupal's core entity access. Multilingual support is only partially implemented and the project advises against multilingual use for now. All administrative and tree-management routes require the 'administer entitree' permission.
